securityBaseline.reason: First commit containing the local-provider classification and redirect refusal (79635f7), the Creator redirect refusal (fa2760e) and the high-advisory dependency fixes (403c8f8). A rollback target must contain it.

forbiddenTargets.reason: Currently deployed preview build; lacks the baseline security fixes. Never a rollback target.

containment.note: If no deployed-and-verified build at or after the baseline exists, contain instead of serving an older build. A build that contains application maintenance mode can be contained with SAKTHIAI_MAINTENANCE_MODE=true (restart required); any other build, including the forbidden 469c668 the preview serves today, can only be contained by suspending the service.

maintenanceMode.behaviour: every route except /healthz, /readyz, /releasez answers 503 before parsing, auth, database, storage, OAuth, tRPC or static handlers; /readyz 503 without probing dependencies; no background runners; unrecognised values fail closed
maintenanceMode.platformMaintenanceMode: The hosting platform's own maintenance setting is not tested here and is not relied on.

buildEvidence.servedIdentity: /releasez artifact.digest (recomputed by the running server; state must be verified)
buildEvidence.retainedArtifact: GitHub Actions artifact release-artifact-<commit> (quality-gate job release-artifact, 90 days)
buildEvidence.hostRebuildTie: digest equality between the served artifact and the retained artifact for the same commit
